title: Substantial Completion, Punch List, Closeout Documents and Warranty Start
content:
# Substantial Completion, Punch List, Closeout Documents and Warranty Start

Closeout basis of Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects, written as the questions the desk answers about the end of a project.

**When is substantial completion reached?** When the installed system runs for its intended use, the required authority inspections have been passed and start-up has been performed where the class includes it. A punch list of minor items does not delay it. The inspections that count are those recorded as passed on the project's own entries, each with its inspection class; an inspection the owner reports as passed but which no entry records has not been passed for this purpose.

**How long is allowed for the punch list and the closeout documents?** The punch list is cleared inside the class's punch list period, and the closeout documents — the start-up report, the warranty registration, the balancing report and the as-built drawings where the class includes them — are delivered inside the class's closeout period. Both periods are counted in business days from substantial completion on the office calendar, which excludes Saturdays, Sundays and the office holidays published for the year.

**When is operator training delivered?** Operator training of the class's hours is delivered before the project closes.

**When does the warranty run?** The contractor's labor warranty on the installed work runs for the class's warranty months from substantial completion. The class's parts warranty runs alongside the manufacturer's rather than after it.

**When does the project close?** The project closes when the punch list is clear, the documents are delivered and the retainage is released.

## Counting a closeout period (hypothetical)

Substantial completion is recorded on a Wednesday and the class's punch list period is 10 business days. Thursday and Friday are days 1 and 2; the following Monday to Friday are days 3 to 7; the Monday to Wednesday after that are days 8 to 10, so the punch list falls due on that Wednesday. A published office holiday on any of those days moves the due day one business day later.

## Truth table for substantial completion (class includes start-up)

| System runs for its intended use | Required authority inspections passed on record | Start-up performed | Punch list items remain | Substantially complete |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| yes | yes | yes | no | yes |
| yes | no | yes | no | no |
| no | yes | yes | no | no |
| yes | yes | no | no | no |
